description: Request that we send a fax (document or text) on behalf of an identified sender and return the transmission report. Nothing is sent before you accept our quote. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 2.90 per fax up to 10 pages.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

document_url.description: Optional: https URL of the PDF to fax.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

name: request_fax
title: Request to send a fax
